messages:
sara (partnerships): Heads up — we're targeting Cabo (apac-sw1) region flip with CloudWave on 2026-04-08. Need quick confirmations: (1) marketplace entitlements live? (2) quota for 4x A100 nodes for launch day? (3) KMS cert path + HSM gating? Reply with short status please. :calendar:

mike (eng-infra): Infra update: submitted quota request to CloudWave portal, ticket #CW-4821. Azure quota needs org approval. Pinging @raj for partner entitlement confirmation. ETA ~48h.

raj (partner-ops): Partner-ops check: marketplace listing is approved but SKU mapping is incomplete — we need canonical sku id (proposed: cw-a100-80gb-prod). Will push mapping json by EOD. CloudWave asking for 10% holdback for trials, is that okay?

elena (CloudWave PM): Confirming from CloudWave: we can enable 4 nodes for the launch window. KMS flow ok with customer-managed keys. Need a service principal + terraform snippet from Redwood to wire to our onboarding. Sending minimal snippet now:
```hcl
resource "azurerm_key_vault" "cw_cabo_kv" {
  name                = "cw-cabo-kv"
  resource_group_name = "cw-cabo-rg"
}
```
We'll also need the SP client id and role assignment.

claire (legal): Legal quick note: joint announcement draft looks fine but we require a short MOU addendum covering entitlements + embargo window. I'll attach a redline this afternoon. No blocker on the launch otherwise.

mike (eng-infra): Perf/ops note: runtime team flagged potential perf delta with A100-80GB + q8 quant profile — we'll run a prewarm plan and enable persistent KV cache for first 6 hours. Can someone reserve oncall for the launch window? @ops-bot assign_oncall cabolaunch 2026-04-08 10:00-16:00

ops-bot: oncall scheduled for cabolaunch: sara, tom, nina. Incident channel created: #launch-cabo-2026. Playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/cabo-launch (restricted).

sara (partnerships): Thanks — next steps checklist:
- raj: send SKU mapping json + marketplace entitlement proof (by EOD)
- elena: confirm SP details + finalize KMS handoff doc (by EOD)
- claire: upload MOU redline (today)
- mike: post prewarm/runbook + confirm perf smoke tests (tomorrow)
If all green by EOD Fri we'll proceed with partner-facing announcement cadence. :thumbsup: Feel free to drop any blockers here.

raj (partner-ops): Will do. Adding mapping file to the shared folder and copying @elena.

elena (CloudWave PM): I'll DM SP creds instructions to @mike and post the KMS handoff doc to the shared drive tonight.

claire (legal): Uploaded redline to drive. Please review and flag any commercial hooks.

mike (eng-infra): Perf smoke scheduled for 2026-04-05 02:00-05:00 UTC. I'll post results here.

sara (partnerships): Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything shifts, tag @sara.
